title: Crew Roles
description: The whole crew roles registry, public/data/canonical/crew_roles.json (RELEASE 1.0 R5 row 7; card release-r5-crew §2, R-R5C-1, on paper before code per R-Y2-1). The eight roles THE SHIP's CREW tab draws, in drawn order. Written by scripts/canonical/build_crew_roles.py; read by lib/shared/vesselView.jsx (CrewTab, CrewActions) on both hosts. RAW prints no stations: any crew member may try any action that is not Pilot Only (AoR Core p.248), so a role is a display grouping, never a gate.

cite.description: The printed pages the roles' actions and the two declines are read from.

id.description: The role a crew entry's `role` names (rec.crew[].role). Unchanged vocabulary: pilot, copilot, gunner, engineer, astrogator, sensors, commander, crew.

label.description: The role's heading on the CREW tab and its CREW ACTIONS group. The copy sweep's words (R-CVS-14).

line.description: The role's one line under its heading on the CREW tab. The copy sweep's words (R-CVS-14).

actions.description: maneuvers_actions.json starship row ids this role's CREW ACTIONS group shows first, in drawn order: its Maneuver rows as names, its Action rows as cards. A DISPLAY GROUPING, NEVER A GATE: no resolver reads it to allow or refuse (R-F54C-1's tripwire). Pilot Only, read from the row, stays the only restriction.

ogg_keys.description: OggDude VehPositions.xml Keys this role answers to (card release-r5-crew §2's table). ASTRO and MOUNT are declined in Docs/RELEASE_1_0_DECLINED.json, registry crew_roles.
